 ORDER Heard and perused the record.
1. This is the first bail application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail in relation to Crime No.532/2023 registered at Police Station Bhikangaon, District Khargone for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366-A, 344, 376,
376(2)(n) of IPC along with 3/4, 5(l)/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 Mahesh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/185572635/
1 and he is in custody since 10.10.2023.
2. Allegation against the applicant is that of abduction and commission of rape with the prosecutrix.
3.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in this case.
As per prosecution case the age of the prosecutrix is 16 years and as per her statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C prosecutrix appears to be a consenting party.
She has deposed that they both have married and they have also resided together for more than one month.
The applicant is in jail since 10.10.2023 and the conclusion of the trial will take a long time.
Under these circumstances, he prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
4. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer and prays for its rejection.
5. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and looking to the facts and circumstances of the case and the custody period of the applicant, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, without commenting on the merits of the case, bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of the applicant, stands allowed.

6. It is directed that the applicant/accused be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for securing his presence before the said Court on all the dates of hearing fixed in this regard during trial.

It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of the Cr.P.C.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
8. This M.Cr.C stands allowed and disposed of.
Certified copy as per rules.
(PREM NARAYAN SINGH) JUDGE sumathi Mahesh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/185572635/
